title: Snapshot versions and replay recorded responses
summary: Save inputs/configuration, prompt/rubric/model versions and before/after artifacts.
body: Save inputs/configuration, prompt/rubric/model versions and before/after artifacts. Recorded-response replay diagnoses deterministic code without repeated model calls. A running timer is not evidence of progress: repeated identical outputs, unchanged failures or exhausted repair allowance require an explicit stop. These are small execution-record extensions, not four platforms.
